title: Li Jiaqi's Livestream Is Selling Tokens Too! AI Computing Power and Smart Hardware Make Their Debut at Double 11 Entertainment Director

content_html:
According to an event announcement, at 19:30 tonight, Li Jiaqi's Tmall Double 11 livestream will list Token (word unit) products for the first time, bringing AI compute services into the sales scene of a top e-commerce livestream. This is also the first time that a streamer's livestream has put AI compute products on sale, marking the further extension of Token commercialization into the mass consumer market.

In this livestream, Chen Yusen, CEO of Qwen Office, will appear as a guest in Li Jiaqi's livestream. Public information shows that Chen Yusen is Alibaba's youngest vice president and, like Li Jiaqi, was born in 1992. In addition to Tokens, the livestream will also showcase products such as AI computers, AI voice-recording cards, and desktop robots.

Among them, the three AI computers are the Lecoo Air, Machenike Shuguang 16S Youth Edition, and Lenovo Zhaoyang Yue Plus, all with Qwen Office built in. This livestream brings Tokens and AI hardware products together into the Double 11 consumption scene, which not only expands the sales channels for AI compute services but also reflects how AI products are accelerating their penetration from technical services and professional tools into the mass retail market.
